content: First, in an attempt to obtain the query-terms, we selected the 100 words which occurred most frequently in the DISC corpus, in comparison with their frequencies in our own scraped tweets corpus. Words that were clearly not indicators of emotion were removed. The rest was annotated per emotion or removed if it was unclear to which emotion the word belonged. This allowed us to create silver datasets per emotion, assigning tweets to an emotion if an annotated emotion-word occurred in the tweet.
